units.title: 投诉与道歉 · 情景对话

items.prompt: Hello. The coffee maker I received today is cracked and does not work.
items.answer: Hello. The coffee maker I received today is cracked and does not work.

hints.zh: 您好，我今天收到的咖啡机有裂痕，而且无法使用。
hints.en: The customer clearly describes the damaged product.
hints.ja: 客が商品の破損と故障を説明します。

items.hint: 您好，我今天收到的咖啡机有裂痕，而且无法使用。 / The customer clearly describes the damaged product. / 客が商品の破損と故障を説明します。
items.phonetic: /həˈloʊ ðə ˈkɑfi ˈmeɪkɚ aɪ ɹəˈsivd təˈdeɪ ɪz kɹækt ən dəz nɑt wɝk/

dialogueScenes.zh: 女顾客向男客服投诉刚收到的商品已损坏。
dialogueScenes.en: A female customer reports a damaged delivery to a male service agent.
dialogueScenes.ja: 女性客が届いた破損商品について男性担当者に申し出ます。

items.prompt: I am very sorry about that. Could you give me your order number?
items.answer: I am very sorry about that. Could you give me your order number?

hints.zh: 对此我非常抱歉。可以告诉我订单号吗？
hints.en: The agent apologizes and asks for the order number.
hints.ja: 担当者が謝罪し、注文番号を尋ねます。
